mapper.select: SELECT id,article_id,article_version,content_hash,article_status,index_status,index_name,index_version, chunk_count,last_event_id,indexed_time,retry_count,last_error FROM knowledge_index_state WHERE article_id=#{articleId} AND deleted=0 LIMIT 1

SELECT id,article_id,article_version,content_hash,article_status,index_status,index_name,index_version, chunk_count,last_event_id,indexed_time,retry_count,last_error FROM knowledge_index_state WHERE deleted=0 ORDER BY article_id ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE knowledge_index_state SET article_version=#{articleVersion},content_hash=#{contentHash}, article_status=#{articleStatus},index_status=#{indexStatus},index_name=#{indexName}, index_version=#{indexVersion},chunk_count=#{chunkCount},last_event_id=#{lastEventId}, indexed_time=#{indexedTime},retry_count=0,last_error=NULL,update_time=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id=#{id} AND deleted=0
